app.title: Wheel of Fate
app.tagline: Upright to boost yourself. Reversed to trip the players ahead.
lang.label: Language
board.label: Zodiac board
piece.label: {element} piece
trap.label: {trap} on {sign}
preview.title: Asset preview
preview.note: Milestone 2: board, element icons, pieces and card art. Not the game screen yet.
preview.boardNote: Sample position: Fire on Aries, Earth and Water on Gemini, Air on Leo; a Chain Trap on Virgo and an Illusion Trap on Scorpio.
preview.cardsNote: Illustrations only. The frame, name and effect text are drawn in code (milestone 3).
face.wands.upright.name: Ignite
face.wands.reversed.name: Smoke
face.wands.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you is Slowed next turn.
face.pentacles.upright.name: Harvest
face.pentacles.reversed.name: Tax
face.pentacles.reversed.text: Steal {steal|Fate Point|Fate Points} from every player ahead of you.
face.swords.upright.name: Tailwind
face.swords.upright.text: This turn, roll the Fate Die twice and keep the higher result. Gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.swords.reversed.name: Cut
face.swords.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}.
face.cups.upright.name: Overflow
face.cups.reversed.name: Heartache
face.cups.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you discards {discard|random card|random cards}.
face.page.upright.name: Swift Message
face.page.upright.text: Move forward to the next Air sign and draw {draw|card|cards}.
face.page.reversed.name: Rumour
face.page.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}, discards {discard|random card|random cards} and is Silenced next turn.
face.knight.upright.name: Charge
face.knight.upright.text: Move forward to the next Fire sign, then {extra|more space|more spaces}.
face.knight.reversed.name: Joust
face.knight.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back to the previous Earth sign and is Stunned next turn.
face.queen.upright.name: Grace
face.queen.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}, gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points} and become Shielded.
face.queen.reversed.name: Scorn
face.queen.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back to the previous Fire sign and loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.king.upright.name: Dominion
face.king.reversed.name: Tyranny
face.king.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces} and is Silenced next turn. All other players are Drained next turn.
face.fool.upright.name: Leap of Faith
face.fool.upright.text: Roll the Fate Die and move forward that many spaces + {bonus}.
face.fool.reversed.name: Wrong Turn
face.fool.reversed.text: Choose a player ahead of you. On their next Move step, they move back {back|space|spaces} instead of rolling{leader}.
face.magician.upright.name: Conjure
face.magician.upright.text: Draw {draw|card|cards}. You may immediately play up to {extraPlays|Minor card|Minor cards} without using your action.
face.magician.reversed.name: Sleight of Hand
face.magician.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader}. Steal a random card from them.
face.highPriestess.upright.name: Foresight
face.highPriestess.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}. Look at the top {look} cards: use the upright effect of one Minor card among them and add another to your hand.
face.highPriestess.reversed.name: Veil
face.highPriestess.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader} and is Slowed next turn. Look at their hand and discard {discard|card|cards} of your choice.
face.empress.upright.name: Abundance
face.empress.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}, gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points} and draw {draw|card|cards}.
face.empress.reversed.name: Overgrowth
face.empress.reversed.text: A player ahead of you is Rooted next turn, loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points} and moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader}.
face.emperor.upright.name: Command
face.emperor.upright.text: Gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points} and become Shielded. Your Move roll this turn counts as {roll}.
face.emperor.reversed.name: Decree
face.emperor.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader} and is Silenced next turn.
face.hierophant.upright.name: Blessing
face.hierophant.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}. Remove all your negative statuses, gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points}, draw {draw|card|cards} and become Shielded.
face.hierophant.reversed.name: Penance
face.hierophant.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back to the previous Earth sign{leader}.
face.lovers.upright.name: Slipstream
face.lovers.upright.text: Move to the space of the nearest player ahead of you (up to {range} spaces away). If no one is that close, move forward {fallback|space|spaces}.
face.lovers.reversed.name: Heartbreak
face.lovers.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back to the space of the nearest player behind them (at most {max} spaces; otherwise {fallback}), then {more|more space|more spaces}{leader}.
face.chariot.upright.name: Full Speed
face.chariot.reversed.name: Ram
face.chariot.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader} and is Slowed next turn.
face.strength.upright.name: Courage
face.strength.upright.text: Move forward to the next Fire sign.
face.strength.reversed.name: Intimidate
face.strength.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader}, is Stunned next turn and loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.hermit.upright.name: Retreat
face.hermit.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}, gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points}, draw {draw|card|cards} and become Shielded.
face.hermit.reversed.name: Isolation
face.hermit.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader} and is Drained next turn.
face.wheelOfFortune.upright.name: Fortune
face.wheelOfFortune.upright.text: Roll the Fate Die twice. Move forward the lower result and gain Fate Points equal to the higher result.
face.wheelOfFortune.reversed.name: The Wheel Turns
face.wheelOfFortune.reversed.text: A player ahead of you rolls the Fate Die and moves back that many spaces{leader}.
face.justice.upright.name: Equity
face.justice.upright.text: If you are not leading, move forward half the distance to the leading player (round up, at least {min}, at most {max}). If you are leading, move forward {moveIfLeading|space|spaces} and gain {fpIfLeading|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.justice.reversed.name: Verdict
face.justice.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader} and loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.hangedMan.upright.name: Sacrifice
face.hangedMan.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}, gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points}, draw {draw|card|cards} and become Shielded. You are Slowed next turn.
face.hangedMan.reversed.name: Suspend
face.hangedMan.reversed.text: A player ahead of you is Rooted and Drained next turn{leader}.
face.death.upright.name: Rebirth
face.death.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}. Discard any number of cards, then draw until you have {handTo}. Remove all your negative statuses and gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.death.reversed.name: Reap
face.death.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader} and loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.temperance.upright.name: Flow
face.temperance.upright.text: Move forward to the next Water sign.
face.temperance.reversed.name: Restraint
face.temperance.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces} and is Slowed for their next {turns} turns{leader}.
face.devil.upright.name: Pact
face.devil.upright.text: Gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points} and move forward {move|space|spaces}. You are Drained next turn.
face.devil.reversed.name: Chains
face.devil.reversed.text: Place a Chain Trap {reach} signs in front of a player ahead of you. Whoever passes it is Rooted next turn and loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points}{leader}.
face.tower.upright.name: Lightning Dash
face.tower.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces} ({moveIfLeading} if you are leading), then discard your whole hand.
face.tower.reversed.name: Collapse
face.tower.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader}.
face.star.upright.name: Hope
face.star.upright.text: Move forward to the next Water sign. If you have fewer than {fpFloor} Fate Points, restore them to {fpFloor}.
face.star.reversed.name: Falling Star
face.star.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader}. Steal {steal|Fate Point|Fate Points} from them.
face.moon.upright.name: Night Walk
face.moon.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}. Traps do not affect you until your next turn.
face.moon.reversed.name: Illusion
face.moon.reversed.text: Place an Illusion Trap {reach} signs in front of a player ahead of you. Whoever passes it moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader} and stops.
face.sun.upright.name: Radiance
face.sun.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces} and gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.sun.reversed.name: Scorch
face.sun.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader}, is Slowed next turn and loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.judgement.upright.name: Calling
face.judgement.upright.text: Discard up to {max} cards. Move forward 1 space for each card discarded, then draw {draw|card|cards}.
face.judgement.reversed.name: Reckoning
face.judgement.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back half the distance between you (round up, at most {max}{leader}).
face.world.upright.name: Completion
face.world.upright.text: Once per game: move forward to Pisces, the last sign before Aries (at most {max} spaces).
face.world.reversed.name: Standstill
face.world.reversed.text: Once per game: every player ahead of you is Rooted next turn{leader}.
face.world.reversed.leader: and the leader also moves back {lead|space|spaces}
status.slowed.desc: Your Move step goes exactly 1 space: no roll, reroll or boost.
status.silenced.desc: You cannot play cards (no Minor card, no court combo).
status.drained.desc: You cannot spend Fate Points; you still gain them.
status.stunned.desc: You skip Play and Flip: you only draw and move.
status.rooted.desc: You skip your Move step. Card effects still move you.
status.wrongTurn.desc: Your next Move step goes back {n|space|spaces} instead of rolling.
status.shielded.desc: Blocks the next reversed effect or trap. If it blocks nothing, it ends after your next turn and gives back 1 Fate Point.
status.trapImmune.desc: Traps do not affect you until your next turn.
reason.notInHand: That card is not in your hand.
reason.notMinor: Only Minor cards can be played this way.
reason.silenced: You are Silenced: no cards this turn.
reason.drained: You are Drained: you cannot spend Fate Points.
reason.cooldown: You used your skill last turn. It is ready next turn.
reason.onceUsed: This face is once per game and already used.
reason.noTarget: No player is ahead of you.
reason.needFuel: Needs two Minor cards of the elements shown.
reason.invalidFuel: Needs two other Minor cards from your hand.
reason.trapThere: There is already a trap on that sign.
reason.invalidSign: A trap must go 1–3 signs in front of a player ahead of you.
reason.cannotReroll: No reroll: one per turn, not after a boost, and it costs 1 Fate Point.
reason.cannotBoost: No boost: one per turn, and it costs 2 Fate Points.
log.gameStart: New game: {laps|lap|laps} to win. Turn order: {order}.
log.reshuffle: The discard pile becomes the new deck ({n} cards).
log.actionSkipped: {player} is Stunned and skips Play and Flip.
log.play.foresight: {player} uses {card} {side} from the top of the deck: {face}.
log.move.wrongTurn: {player} takes a wrong turn and moves back {n|space|spaces}: {from} → {to}.
log.fp.gainCapped: {player} +{n} FP ({reason}); {lost} over the limit of 10 is lost.
log.discard.limit: {player} discards {cards} down to the hand limit.
log.status.wrongTurn: {player} will take a Wrong Turn on their next move.
log.finishSafe: {player} is past the finish and is not affected.
log.trapBlocked: {player} springs the {trap} on {sign}, but the shield blocks it.
log.moveSkipped.rooted: {player} is Rooted and does not move.
log.finalRound: {player} reached the finish. This is the final round!
log.take: {player} adds a card to their hand.
setup.fact.players: 2–4 players, any mix of people and computer players on one screen.
setup.fact.time: About 10 rounds with 3 players and 3 laps.
setup.fact.characters: Everyone gets a random character card, upright or reversed.
setup.playersHint: Choose who sits at each element. Turn order is Fire, Earth, Air, Water.
setup.seedHint: The same seed and players give the same shuffle and rolls.
setup.orderHint: The first player moves on by one seat every round.
game.skipTitle: Skip the animations and the computer turns until your next decision.
game.handHiddenHint: Hands stay hidden until the next player takes the device.
decide.playCardHint: Click a card in your hand to see both sides and play it.
decide.conjure: Conjure: you may play {n|more Minor card|more Minor cards}.
decide.conjureHint: Click a Minor card in your hand, or finish.
decide.foresight: Foresight: use the upright effect of one Minor card, and take another card.
decide.veil: Veil: look at {player}'s hand and choose {n|card|cards} to discard.
decide.discardToLimit: Too many cards: discard {n} down to {limit}.
decide.pickSign: Choose a sign on the board (dashed outline).
decide.selectDiscard: Select the cards to discard in your hand: {n} selected.
handoff.title: Pass to {player}
handoff.text: Hands stay hidden until the next player is ready.
over.title: Game over
